verdict.rationale: llamafile's own docs say models run entirely on-device with no cloud or data sharing and 'full control over compute, data, and cost.' Its server sandbox blocks outbound connections, and a community user confirmed it runs with zero network connection. That keeps all data local and under the user's control. However, nothing documents explicit retention or deletion controls. Missing for 10: documented retention settings, explicit deletion controls for chat history, slot or cache data, and any description of what the server or Web UI persists.
